FeliciaOS Market Scanner 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Launch of autonomous crypto market intelligence tool.
- Provides macro market sentiment, technical analysis, and on-chain pre-pump signals.
- Offers risk management advice, including stop-loss and position sizing.
- Generates a curated watchlist of 3–5 tokens with explanations.
- Requires GROQ_API_KEY for LLaMA 3.3 70B inference.
